title: Building a predictive model to identify clinical indicators for COVID-19 using machine learning method
summary: An Explainable Boosting Machine selected COVID-19 indicators and a decision tree interpreted them in a case-control comparison with community-acquired pneumonia. The five indicator combinations achieved reported differentiation of 83.3–100%; the retrospective study calls for further verification.
